Citation Act

  • CURIE: gmeow:CitationAct
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CitationAct
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/citations

A reified citation: a citing entity cites a cited entity with a typed intent, optionally via a selector (a pinpoint into the cited work), carrying provenance, confidence, and standpoint. Replaces the old hasSource/citesSource: genealogical evidence is a CitationAct with intent intentCitesAsDataSource toward a creative work, via a selector.

Structure

Subclass of: gufo:Relator

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:CitationAct as a specialized kind of gufo:Relator. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
